plan: OpenVibe.Tours: go anywhere — fly, stay, walk, watch — from open data (OpenStreetMap, Wikivoyage, Wikidata), IRL tours on OpenVibe.Live, stays from OpenVibe.Rent, self-guided routes, a flight link-out and shareable trips
summary: OpenVibe.Tours is the travel room. The top 100 cities come from Wikidata coordinates and Wikivoyage pages; places are OpenStreetMap tourism=* through one bounded Overpass query per city; self-guided routes are generated from Wikivoyage See lists, marked as generated, and cite every stop. IRL streams, VODs and clips come from OpenVibe.Live's public list, stays from OpenVibe.Rent's public listings. There is no flight API key in v1: the form links the official airline-neutral search with the city pair filled in and no affiliate. A signed-in person can make a trip with a city, dates, saved places, one route and stays, and share it read-only. No route needs a service token; the source jobs are off under TOURS_DRILL.
works: A place database from OpenStreetMap tourism=*, with each OSM object URL and fetch time
The top 100 cities resolved through Wikidata (coordinates, population, country, image) and Wikivoyage (summary + See lists)
Wikimedia Commons image licence and credit on every city image
A page per city and per place with sources and TouristDestination/TouristAttraction JSON-LD
A deterministic place of the day, the same for everyone all day
Self-guided routes generated from Wikivoyage See lists, marked generated, with a cited note and page URL at every stop
MapLibre + OpenStreetMap tiles on a route page, with a complete SVG map, stop list and map links without JavaScript
IRL tours now, recent IRL VODs and clips from OpenVibe.Live; a city only when the public title or tags name one
Stays from OpenVibe.Rent's public listings, read-only, never a payment
A flight form that opens the official airline-neutral search with the city pair and dates, no affiliate
A signed-in trip: city, dates, saved places, one route, stays, shareable read-only; owner-only edit and delete
GET /api/v1/cities, /cities/:slug, /places/:id, /routes/:id, /live, trips CRUD and an OpenAPI 3.1 document
Server-rendered home with hero, live rail, place of the day, top cities, routes, stays, scenes, FAQ and developers
Network sign-in with PKCE S256 (tours_at/tours_rt/tours_oauth); account deletion erases trips
Every source job records status, counts and error in tours_job_runs; jobs are off under TOURS_DRILL
Discovery artifacts; trips and the API are excluded
Deploy files copied from Meme with the names and port changed
notYet: A flight API key or adapter: v1 is a link to the official neutral search, with no price claim and no affiliate
Duffel/Kiwi search: the seam exists but no adapter; a key alone leaves it off
Speech audio on route stops: OpenVibe.AI has no speech-synthesis route today
Opening-hours parsing (raw OSM value shown), offline route download, recorded chaptered tours, robot tours
Group voting, a trip diary, flight alerts, partner booking and payouts (v2/v3)
Any write to OpenVibe.Live or OpenVibe.Rent: both are read-only public APIs here
A city search beyond the top-100 catalogue
features: self-guided routes from Wikivoyage See lists
IRL live tours, VODs and clips
official flight search link-out, no affiliate
signed-in trips with a read-only share link
deployment: not deployed: the unit and nginx vhost are deploy/systemd/openvibe-tours.service and deploy/nginx/openvibe.tours.conf
